source: Trimmed from the 2026-09-25 dynasty research prospects.json (scratchpad/dynasty/prospect_curve.js): pMake = P(200 NHL GP) or a 40-start goalie season, from NHL GP so far / NHLe translation / draft slot, with a capped scouting (tier) logit shift; fpgIfMake = prime FP/G at 25 on the realized scale; eta = first regular season if he makes it. comp = prior components (draft slot, NHLe, scouting tier) for the young-player convergence.
